# ui::Mdl2Palette

Header: `winui/ui/themes/Mdl2Palette.hpp`.

The 24 base colors of the MDL2 theme. The `page_*` colors are the page color and the `text_*` colors the text color, each named after its opacity: 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 %. The `list_*` colors are the text color at 10 and 20 %. The two sets swap between light and dark. Keep them translucent. A disabled or secondary color is the text color blended over whatever is behind it, and an opaque gray mixed against the page looks wrong over a selection or an image. Most `chrome` colors are opaque grays that differ between the themes, which gives MDL2 chrome its weight without an accent.

[Theme::mdl2()](theme.md#mdl2) derives every control color from one of these palettes plus the accent.

Example: 
```cpp
// White text on a black page, with a blue accent.
const ui::Mdl2Palette palette = ui::Mdl2Palette::mdl2_dark();
window.pin_theme(ui::Theme::mdl2(palette, /*dark=*/true, ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF0078D7)));

// Secondary text in the text color at 60 %, blended over whatever is behind it.
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .content = {
        ui::Text{.text = "Now playing"},
        ui::Text{.text = "Track 3 of 12", .foreground = palette.text_60},
    },
});
```

## page_100

```cpp
Color page_100
```

The page color at full opacity: white in light, black in dark.

## page_20

```cpp
Color page_20
```

The page color at 20 %.

## page_60

```cpp
Color page_60
```

The page color at 60 %, the inner focus ring.

## page_80

```cpp
Color page_80
```

The page color at 80 %.

## page_40

```cpp
Color page_40
```

The page color at 40 %.

## text_100

```cpp
Color text_100
```

The text color at full opacity: black in light, white in dark.

## text_20

```cpp
Color text_20
```

The text color at 20 %, a button's fill at rest.

## text_60

```cpp
Color text_60
```

The text color at 60 %, secondary text and borders.

## text_80

```cpp
Color text_80
```

The text color at 80 %, the border of an unchecked check box or radio button.

## text_40

```cpp
Color text_40
```

The text color at 40 %, disabled text and a pressed button's fill.

## chrome_contrast

```cpp
Color chrome_contrast
```

An opaque near-black in light (`#171717`) and near-white in dark (`#F2F2F2`).

## black_100

```cpp
Color black_100
```

Opaque black in both themes.

## black_20

```cpp
Color black_20
```

Black at 20 % in both themes.

## black_40

```cpp
Color black_40
```

Black at 40 % in both themes.

## black_80

```cpp
Color black_80
```

Black at 80 % in both themes.

## chrome_disabled_faint

```cpp
Color chrome_disabled_faint
```

An opaque gray for disabled chrome such as a disabled slider: `#CCCCCC` in light, `#333333` in dark.

## chrome_disabled_strong

```cpp
Color chrome_disabled_strong
```

The other disabled-chrome gray, also a text field's border: `#7A7A7A` in light, `#858585` in dark.

## chrome_strong

```cpp
Color chrome_strong
```

The strongest opaque chrome gray, the window border and a pressed slider thumb: `#CCCCCC` in light, `#767676` in dark.

## chrome_faint

```cpp
Color chrome_faint
```

The faintest opaque chrome surface: `#F2F2F2` in light, `#171717` in dark.

## chrome_mid

```cpp
Color chrome_mid
```

A mid opaque chrome surface, the title bar: `#E6E6E6` in light, `#1F1F1F` in dark.

## chrome_flyout

```cpp
Color chrome_flyout
```

[Flyout](../controls/flyout.md#uiflyout), menu and tooltip backgrounds: `#F2F2F2` in light, `#2B2B2B` in dark.

## white_100

```cpp
Color white_100
```

Opaque white in both themes, text on an accent fill.

## list_hover

```cpp
Color list_hover
```

The text color at 10 %, a list row or menu item under the pointer.

## list_pressed

```cpp
Color list_pressed
```

The text color at 20 %, a list row pressed.

## page_background

```cpp
Color page_background
```

The page background: `#FFFFFFFF` in light and `#FF000000` in dark. A field of its own, although it equals [`page_100`](#page_100).

## mdl2_light

```cpp
static Mdl2Palette mdl2_light()
```

The light palette: black text colors over a white page, and light-gray chrome.

## mdl2_dark

```cpp
static Mdl2Palette mdl2_dark()
```

The dark palette: white text colors over a black page. It is the era's default theme. The era's guidance is light for productivity apps, dark for media apps, and the system setting if neither fits.
